response.overview: When PR executive Faye has a breakdown while trying to spin her company’s toxic waste scandal, they send her to their forest retreat to recover.  But forest guardians transport her into an infected woodland scarred by the toxic waste, and then into the fey realm itself.  Confronted by two fey, Fern and Flora, Faye must reckon with her role in the damage being done—and her capacity to help heal it. Faye learns she was once one of them and has abandoned her mission to help humans reconnect with and heal the Earth.  Through surreal encounters, fractured memories, and absurd humour, she reclaims her fey powers and returns to the human world determined to push her company toward real change.  FAYE is a quirky fantasy short with an eco-heart, blending satire and wonder to explore eco-anxiety, burnout, and collective resilience through a distinctly cinematic lens.
response.title: FAYE
